package basispoints

// Runs ONLY in the h22-live tree, next to zz_h25_s2_fixtures_test.go,
// zz_h25_s3_fixtures_test.go, zz_h25_s4_fixtures_test.go and
// zz_h25_s5_fixtures_test.go copied unchanged: records h22's own outputs for
// the H25 S5 cases under every profile. Output path from S5_GOLDEN_OUT.
//
//   git archive h22-live | tar -x -C <dir>
//   cp internal/basispoints/zz_h25_s{2,3,4,5}_fixtures_test.go <dir>/internal/basispoints/
//   cp internal/basispoints/testdata/h22_s5_golden_gen.go.txt <dir>/internal/basispoints/zz_h22_s5_golden_gen_test.go
//   cd <dir> && S5_GOLDEN_OUT=<out.json> go test ./internal/basispoints/ -run TestGenerateS5Golden -count=1

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

type s5Golden struct {
	Generator string                           `json:"generator"`
	Profiles  map[string]map[string][]s5Result `json:"profiles"`
}

// s5ResetH22Caches empties h22's process-wide caches, so every case sees
// exactly the state its own turns build.
func s5ResetH22Caches() {
	nativeCallCache.Lock()
	nativeCallCache.items = map[string]nativeCallEntry{}
	nativeCallCache.order = nil
	nativeCallCache.Unlock()
	namespaceCache.Lock()
	namespaceCache.items = map[string]map[string]string{}
	namespaceCache.order = nil
	namespaceCache.Unlock()
	turnIDCache.Lock()
	turnIDCache.items = map[string]turnIDEntry{}
	turnIDCache.order = nil
	turnIDCache.Unlock()
}

func TestGenerateS5Golden(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("S5_GOLDEN_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("S5_GOLDEN_OUT not set")
	}
	golden := s5Golden{Generator: "h22-live " + Version, Profiles: map[string]map[string][]s5Result{}}
	turns := 0
	for _, profile := range s5Profiles() {
		cases := map[string][]s5Result{}
		for _, c := range s5Cases() {
			if _, exists := cases[c.Name]; exists {
				t.Fatalf("duplicate case %s", c.Name)
			}
			s5ResetH22Caches()
			cases[c.Name] = s5RunCase(t, profile, c, "")
			turns += len(c.Turns)
		}
		golden.Profiles[profile.Name] = cases
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(golden, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("profiles=%d turns=%d", len(golden.Profiles), turns)
}
